products.body_html: Pokemon Trading Card Game (TCG) is a collectible card game for two players, based on the Pokemon anime (and video game) franchise. Players can collect cards representing their favourite Pokemon, from throughout the franchise's history, build a team and battle it out. Originally published by Wizards of the Coast in 1996, it is (since 2003) now published by The Pokemon Company. over 30 billion cards have been sold worldwide since the games initial release.To play the game you will require a 60-card deck, either pre-constructed, or customised, from your personal card collection. You will also need some way to track damage and conditions.Vivid Voltage is the fourth expansion of the Sword & Shield series, originally released in 2020. The expansion contains 203 cards and features Generation VIII Pokemon, Pokemon V, and Pokemon VMAX. Versions of VMAX Pokemon include Pikachu, Togekiss, and Aegislash. Pokemon V versions include Steelix, Alakazam, Talonflame, and Ampharos.Secret Rares in this expansion include: Galarian Obstagoon, Oranguru, Memory Capsule, and Leon.Each Pokemon TCG Sowrd & Shield Vivid Voltage Booster Box contains 36 10-card, semi-randomised Booster packs. Each Booster pack also contains a code card for Pokemon TCG Online. Each code will enable the player to obtain a virtual booster pack, to supplement their online collection.Player Count: 2Time: 10 - 100 minutesAge: 6+

The Pokemon Trading Card Game (TCG) is a collectible card game based on the popular Pokemon franchise, where players use decks of cards to battle against each other. Each card in the game represents a different Pokemon, with its own unique abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

Players start by building a deck of 60 cards, which can include Pokemon cards, Trainer cards, and Energy cards. Pokemon cards represent the various creatures that can be found in the Pokemon world, and each card features the Pokemon's name, picture, and a description of its attacks and abilities. Trainer cards provide different effects that can help players during the game, such as drawing additional cards or healing their Pokemon. Energy cards provide the energy necessary to power a Pokemon's attacks.

During a game of Pokemon TCG, players take turns playing cards and attacking each other's Pokemon. Each Pokemon has a certain number of hit points (HP), and when its HP is reduced to zero, it is knocked out and sent to the discard pile. The first player to knock out all of their opponent's Pokemon wins the game.

products.title: Pokemon TCG: Sword & Shield - Battle Styles - Booster Box
products.body_html:
Charge into the fray with the Pokemon Trading Card Game: Battle Styles!

The next chapter in the Sword and Shield series is here! Battle Styles brings forward a new mechanic , the Strike system. Using this, as well as the wealth of cards added that play around this ability, you can use power plays much earlier. The stars of the show, Urshifu - Rapid Strike and Urshifu - Single Strike show this in style! Rapid Strike Pokemon want to play tricky and sway in and out of battle, slowly chipping away the opponent's health! Single Strike, though, comes packed with attacks dealing over 200 damage in some cases! Watch out though, they're not completely safe! You could end up losing energies, items or even benched Pokemon in return for this powerful onslaught!

Other Pokemon return with a vengeance as well! For a Rapid Strike deck, options like Empoleon V, Octillery and Mienshao can form a strong backline. Trainer cards like Fan of Waves, Tower of Waters and Korrina's Focus will also help out! Single Strike packs powerhouses like Primape, Tyranitar V and Houndoom to really lay the smackdown! With Bruno and Single Strike Scroll of Scorn on your side, your opponent will definitely feel it!

Each Booster Pack contains 10 packs, and each box contains 36 packs.
